desc:
🌱 Bring an entire planet back to life in Regrowth Incremental!

Extract Energy from a mysterious rock with a Singularity at its core. Unlock upgrades, discover new currencies, and restore the world around you as you progress through four major chapters.

⚡ 585 unique upgrades
📖 6 major chapters
💎 75+ currencies

🔓 Currently in Alpha!
Purchase Alpha access to receive exclusive rewards when the game releases and help shape the future of Regrowth Incremental. Your feedback matters!
🔧 During Alpha, the game is currently receiving updates almost everyday

✅ For More Information towards release or gameplay please join the community server

Extra Rewards:
🔔 Join the Group for 1.25x Energy
👍 Like & favorite for In Game-Boosts
🗨️ Join the Community Server for Codes
